messages:
cassie: Heads-up — AcmeX POC needs a temporary per-token override for hosted embeddings. They estimate ~200M tokens over 4 weeks. Can we get a rate floor change for the POC?
ryan: What is their current commit / expected ARR if POC converts?
cassie: POC -> potential $360k ARR if it converts. They want lower unit price to validate latency/cost. No committed spend today.
leo: Full ask? Discounted per-1k rate + a min monthly charge? Or just a one-off credit?
cassie: Prefer per-token override for the POC window (4 weeks). Proposal on the table: temporarily 0.003 / 1k tokens for embeddings, capped at 300M tokens, and a $3k min charge for the month.
r yan: (typo) — ryan: can we see math. 200M tokens => how many 1k units?
cassie: 200,000 units * 0.003 = $600. But we want to ensure we cover infra, hence the suggested $3k min for that month.
leo: That $3k min is the real ask to protect ops. Do we need approvals from deal desk + finance?
deal-desk-bot: @cassie Please submit the pricing exception form: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk/new. Include POC length, token cap, renewal signal, and legal playbook. Approvals required: Sales Lead, Finance, Legal (if T&Cs change).
maya: Quick note: Hosted pricing override for embeddings impacts our quota throttles — need to pin model variant. Which model are they using?
cassie: Using rwm-large-emb-v2 (quantized). We can route them to dedicated smaller instance for predictability.
finance-team: From finance: $3k min seems fine for a short POC if sales signs MSA / LOI. We need a brief forecast: probability to close and expected time to commit.
leo: I'll draft the exception in the form. Cassie — can you paste the usage profile (tokens/day) and the security checklist status?
cassie: Usage profile: ~5M tokens/day for 40 days peak, then taper. Security: SAML SSO in place, data retention flagged (they want 30d). No data residency needs.
leo: Drafted PR: 
```
POC Token Override Request
Account: AcmeX
Window: 4 weeks (2026-04-12 -> 2026-05-09)
Model: rwm-large-emb-v2 (hosted)
Override: 0.003 / 1k tokens for embeddings
Cap: 300M tokens
Min charge: $3,000 for POC month
Conditions: MSA signed or LOI within 30 days of POC end; route to dedicated pool; no change to TOS
Approvals required: Sales Lead, Finance, Legal
```
ryan: Looks reasonable. Legal: any extra clauses?
leo: Legal asked for standard POC addendum and to confirm no custom data residency. Cassie confirmed.
deal-desk-bot: @leo Request submitted. Current status: pending finance approval. Reference DD-2026-089.
finance-team: Approved for trial discount. Please ensure billing can enforce cap and min. Ops: can you set an automated cap at 300M tokens and fallback to standard pricing once reached?
maya: Ops note: we can implement a routing policy to enforce cap + fallback to standard rate; we'll add an alert at 80% of cap. Need the account ID to hook billing.
cassie: Account ID 9f4e. I've uploaded the security checklist and LOI template to the deal doc.
leo: Final step: Sales lead sign-off. @ryan can you +1 so we can publish the override and invoice the $3k min?
ryan: +1 :thumbsup:
cassie: Thanks team — launching POC tomorrow morning. Will share weekly usage snapshots.
deal-desk-bot: Pricing exception active pending billing config. Notifying ops and billing.
